caption: Several ice cubes are dropped into a glass of soda, and the cubes bob up and float near the surface.

sa.check: A glass of soda is present.
Several ice cubes are dropped in.
The cubes bob up and float near the surface.
The drop comes first and the floating follows.

pc.expect: The cubes splash, dip below, and come back up to float with their tops just above the surface.
pc.fail: The cubes sink to the bottom and stay; or they hang mid-glass; or they float entirely above the soda.

pc.expect: The soda level rises as the cubes go in, and fizz bubbles rise.
pc.fail: The level drops; or stays unchanged; or the soda is rigid.

pc.expect: The bobbing dies down and the cubes settle.
pc.fail: They bob harder; or they jump out; or they spin.
Cubes merge; or dissolve instantly; or turn into another object.

pc.expect: The cubes keep their number and the glass stays one glass.
pc.fail: A cube vanishes or a new one appears; or the glass duplicates; or a cube passes through the glass wall.

pc.expect: The soda's colour and the glass stay the same.
pc.fail: The soda changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the background rearranges.
